info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Payments Payments Webhooks-v3-spec
info.description: The Payment Notification Retrieval API facilitates the retrieval of payment event notifications through webhooks. This endpoint allows developers to access crucial updates regarding payment statuses and transactions. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and financial applications that rely on real-time payment processing. By integrating this API, users can enhance their systems with timely notifications and ensure a responsive customer experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve data related to payment webhooks, enabling integration with payment processing services and monitoring events generated by them.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide information related to webhook notifications from the payments API. It is expected to contain relevant details about the payment event that triggered the webhook.

200.description: The request was successful and the webhook data is returned.
